snippet.title: Celebrate Pokémon Day with legendary Pokémon and events in Pokémon UNITE! ✨
snippet.description:
Zapdos is joining the fray in Pokémon UNITE today, February 27!

In addition, the legendary bird Pokémon Articuno and Moltres, as well as Meganium, Typhlosion, and Feraligatr from the Johto region are also confirmed to join the battle! Let's celebrate Pokémon Day with new Pokémon, new events, and more!
